images.E_a: Cinematic, highly detailed, dramatic low-key lighting, deep black background, film grain, spiritual and mysterious mood. A tall elegant antique hourglass made of glass and dark brass stands in the left half of the frame, glowing with warm golden light from within. Inside, the golden sand has almost stopped flowing; a single grain of sand shines brightly like a tiny star as it falls through the narrow neck, frozen in mid-air. Fine golden dust floats softly around the glass. The right half of the frame falls off into near-black darkness. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo. Close and slightly low angle, the glowing grain is the brightest point in the image.
